findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - three parts list an intentionally committed generated API contract. The note says to take the file out of every Scope whenever a script can build it, then says to put its change in one part when the repo keeps it. Both conditions hold for Forge's Python starter: its generator is in `src/forge/templates/starter-python/package.json:9`, and its convention requires committing the output at `src/forge/templates/conventions/python.md:182`. The advice therefore directs the planner both to remove the file from all Scopes and to assign its change to a part. The first instruction needs the stated condition that nobody needs the file stored.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - three parts linked by After all list a generated contract at `spec/openapi.yaml`. The new segment filter skips every path containing `spec`, so the read gives no shared-file note for this exact file. Although the existing overlap check also exempts `spec` paths (`src/forge/task.py:641`), the explicit After chain still makes these parts wait for one another. The approved item does not exclude files in such directories.
